'''Camp E'thok''' was a [[Galak tribe|Galak]] [[centaur]] camp in northwestern [[Thousand Needles]].{{coords|19|22|Thousand Needles}} The centaurs here raided a caravan that the goblin [[Wizlo Bearingshiner]] was in, but could not steal his most prized gadget, as it's tied around the neck of a ferocious panther he owned.
